processing.enc_reading: GDAL/OGR 3.4.0e S-57; default updates APPLY; DSID UPDN checked; raw versions retained
processing.matching: Within 25 m; main characteristic type, known colour/period/explicit group agree; band 5 preferred, band 4 fallback; deduplicate LNAM; reject colocated competing USCG listings. Special positional-only cross-check for 37032 explicitly flagged.
processing.sequence_validation: Parse original SIGSEQ into lit/eclipsed durations; require sum within 0.02 s of SIGPER and no conflicting accepted sequences.
processing.phase: No inter-light phase epoch supplied; any future start offsets are illustrative.
